## Smart Email Unsubscribe Manager

Weekly scan of inbox to detect promotional emails and recommend unsubscriptions.

**Flow:**
1. Weekly schedule trigger (Monday 9 AM)
2. Read all emails from past week
3. Code node detects promotional keywords and scores
4. Deduplicate by sender
5. Report unsubscribe candidates to Google Sheets

**Setup:**
- Connect Gmail OAuth2 credentials
- Connect Google Sheets credentials
- Set spreadsheet ID for the unsubscribe report
